## This week

Orientation (grading, weekly rhythm, presentation assignment) followed by the first lecture: what separates an agent from a chatbot. An agent is a system whose control flow is decided by the model's output; the lecture builds that definition from what an LLM call can and cannot do, then covers the agent loop, the components (Model · Instructions · Tools · Memory), the autonomy spectrum, workflow patterns, and form factors — and closes with the course map: build the agent (W2–4), discipline it (W5), scale it (W6–7), ground and operate it (W9–13).
